description.value: Pho Lan Beef Noodle Soup is a Vietnamese restaurant on Number 3 Road in Richmond specializing in beef noodle soup. It operates on a cash-and-e-transfer model with no credit or debit cards accepted, which is worth noting for cyclists on the road. The restaurant is located along a busy commercial corridor in Richmond's city centre.
